entry.title: Fill in the blank in the quiz: A plague research employee in Russia died from ____
entry.summary: Plus: Nobels! Protests! Ambiguous quotes! A mysterious death in Russia!

entry.title: ChatGPT for Teens has special safeguards. A watchdog group finds most don't work
entry.summary: A study from Common Sense Media says most safeguards in ChatGPT for Teens failed. The chatbot talks to teens like a friend and doesn't alert parents when users talk about self-harm and suicide.

entry.title: Why mailing a ballot close to Election Day may get it rejected for a late postmark
entry.summary: If you're using the U.S. Postal Service to return a ballot close to Election Day, officials recommend getting it postmarked at a post office to avoid getting caught up in mail processing changes.

entry.title: Aaron Sorkin warns of Facebook's recklessness in 'The Social Reckoning'
entry.summary: Sorkin's latest film follows Mark Zuckerberg as his company fights lawsuits and whistleblowers after modifying its algorithm to promote reshares, which overwhelmingly tend to be divisive.

entry.title: South African human rights lawyer Navi Pillay wins the Nobel Peace Prize
entry.summary: South African human rights lawyer Navi Pillay wins the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for advancing human rights and international law.

entry.title: Christa Pike is walking with help and eating after failed execution attempt
entry.summary: Pike has begun walking and eating again at a hospital a week after surviving Tennessee's attempt to execute her with lethal drugs, her attorneys said Thursday.

entry.title: Pentagon says the firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter will be livestreamed
entry.summary: The Pentagon says the firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Malik Hasan will be livestreamed after Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said the execution would be "public.

entry.title: Isaias strengthens into Category 2 hurricane on collision course with the Gulf Coast
entry.summary: The first hurricane of the Atlantic season was forecast to intensify rapidly and cause dangerous conditions in the Florida Panhandle, southern Alabama and southern Mississippi when it makes landfall late Friday or early Saturday.

entry.title: OpenAI caught Russians and Iranians using ChatGPT for influence campaigns
entry.summary: The company says Russian operatives used its AI chatbot to update their bosses, shedding light on influence campaigns previously not attributed to Russia.

entry.title: The long-deployed USS Lincoln returns home to San Diego Bay
entry.summary: The USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier has returned home after a record-setting uninterrupted time at sea supporting the Iran war. The extended deployment drew attention following reports of crew stress and supply shortages.
